ms.promise:
The notebook published on a public repository will be the single output, which will show the interaction of the Plutus Smart Contract deployed on Testnet. To get this final completed step, we must do the following intermediary steps (these ste;ps indicate how we get to the completed, published plutus smart contract, but are not outputs themselves): 
・Setup the Plutus environment for development
・Design the Plutus smart contract
・Define contract constraints to ensure a trust-less protocol for financial applications
・Define contract payment mechanism
・Define the refund mechanism
・Develop the Plutus smart contract
・Publish the Plutus smart contract
ms.criteria: The notebook's ability to trigger a transaction on the Plutus Smart Contract through an interaction documented within it.

ms.promise:
Completion of a simple application smart contract that demonstrates the functionality of the harvester service by monitoring a testnet address. To get this final completed step, we must do the following intermediary steps (these steps indicate how we get to the completed Harvester service, but are not outputs themselves):
・Review Marlowe transaction serialization process
・Develop a Wolfram Language script to harvest UTXOs at the smart contract address
・Connection to data provider service Wolfram Price Feed Infrastructure.
・Develop a mechanism to submit a transaction that fulfills the data request
・Notebook as a demonstration of the Harvester service
ms.criteria: Simple application smart contract that demonstrates the harvester service returns the requested values.

ms.promise:
Notebook and documentation of the Marlowe Smart contract available on a public repository that shows the complete flow of the Provider Smart contract and the Harvester service on Testnet. To get this final completed step, we must do the following intermediary steps (these steps indicate how we get to the completed flow of the Provider smart contract and the harvester service on Testnet, but are not outputs themselves): 
・Define a User Contract in Marlowe
・Review Marlowe block components
・Define user constraints to interact with the service
・Implementation of the Marlowe contract
・Test the Marlowe project
・Use a Jupyter notebook as a demonstration
・Publish the Marlowe Notebook
・Documentation
ms.criteria: The acceptance criterion for this output is that the notebook must be publicly accessible and clearly demonstrate the entire operational flow of both the Provider Smart Contract and the Harvester service on the Testnet, with one example.
